title: Brodynelly UI — editable Svelte 5 source and copy-to-source CLI

baseline.note: A proposed profile is not run evidence. Inspect the current tests and run the approved required recipes on this worktree and candidate before claiming a baseline. Results from another worktree/session are not transferable proof.

conventions: This is editable Svelte 5 component source, the showcase, a generated registry and our own copy-to-source CLI; not a runtime component npm package or official shadcn registry.
Preserve the 83 explicit public components in src/lib/index.js and separately imported src/lib/styles.css; update the declared contract deliberately for approved API changes.
Keep zero runtime dependencies and zero peer dependencies in the root package. Development dependencies do not imply a consumer runtime package.
Inspect existing legacy-compatible Svelte syntax; do not silently migrate the whole library to runes or TypeScript.
Preserve classic and Version26 families unless an approved migration changes them; use shared library tokens rather than showcase-only fixes.
Never hand-edit registry payloads. Change source/generator as scoped, run registry:build, then registry:check and applicable registry/installer tests.
Open each task worktree at its own root; explicitly scope npm ci and npm run sync before project checks. Do not borrow another worktree's dependencies or generated state.
No root install/build lifecycle hooks, package identity/version changes or publishing workflows as part of setup; publication and pushing require separate authorization.

recipes.note: Per-worktree prerequisite only when explicitly scoped; inspect package/lock and install side effects. Not blanket script approval or a test pass.
Explicit SvelteKit synchronization in this worktree, not an install lifecycle hook or type-check result.
Optional development server; long-running, not a pass/fail baseline. Stop only your owned process.
Optional preview after site:build; not regression or consumer proof.
Builds the showcase with Vite; writes generated output, not a component package build or installer verification.
Regenerates deterministic copy-to-source payloads; a mutating recipe, never a hand-edit or automatic approval.
Checks generated registry freshness against the exact source candidate.

environment_notes.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH: Optional caller-supplied installed Chromium executable; omit to use Playwright's available Chromium. This note is not an environment assignment.

recipes.note: Vitest run executes browser components and Node tests once, including standalone real-pointer checks outside the browser iframe. Chromium does not prove WebKit/native compatibility. No browser install is implied.
Runs the registry Node tests; inspect assertions/counts for the approved contract.
Runs copy-to-source installer Node tests. Fixtures may write temporary projects; inspect actual scope before execution.
Prettier check then ESLint; inspect current scripts. Does not establish behavior or coverage.

approval_notes: Recipes are proposals, not automatic execution grants or evidence. Confirm required gates and exact script contents in each plan; never save blanket script permissions.
Approve dependency/browser installation, baseline repairs, public API changes, commits and publication explicitly. Do not create an invented base or stage existing user work.
Use PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH only as a caller-provided environment override; no machine path belongs in this profile.
There is no configured svelte-check or coverage gate; do not invent passing type-check/coverage results.
OpenCode configuration checks are static only: node --test .opencode/checks/*.test.mjs. They are not product baseline, native discovery, live permissions or MCP generation proof.
Optional Luuna/Apple/OpenDesign resources are not bundled runtime dependencies. A missing resource blocks only dependent work, not ordinary CLI/build checks.
